title: Treat chronic hepatitis D with an authorized HDV-targeted antiviral

concept.text: Suppress HDV replication and improve liver inflammation using treatment directed at HDV infection. Bulevirtide achieved European authorization, but ongoing treatment should not be represented as a finite cure. Proposed completion test: European Commission marketing authorization following EMA assessment of virological and biochemical response in HDV-RNA-positive patients with compensated liver disease. Test set by: EMA and the European Commission; the clinical programme measures HDV RNA response and ALT normalization. Reported achieved: Hepcludex (bulevirtide) received EU conditional marketing authorization on 31 July 2020, converted to standard authorization on 18 July 2023. Overlaps: INF-11, VIR-03. Sources given: [EMA Hepcludex assessment and authorization history](https://www.ema.europa.eu/de/medicines/human/EPAR/hepcludex) ; [Hepcludex product information](https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/hepcludex-epar-product-information_en.pdf).
